test: IDUI Test 04 (see PROTOCOL.md amendments A3 and A4)
measures: How far apart two frames from the same arm are in the parameter space the shader consumes. Keep rate cannot tell a wide space that lands well apart from a narrow space that only ever makes one picture; this measures the second thing directly.

method.sample: 400 seeds per arm from one fixed SplitMix64 stream (0x0AC71E700000001), 53 numeric dimensions of GeneratedStyle
method.distance: mean pairwise Euclidean distance, each dimension normalised by the widest span any arm reaches in it
method.normalisation_reason: Normalising by one arm's own span is wrong: arm A pins exitDistance at 0, so that dimension had no denominator and C's 7-13 world units entered raw. That alone once reported C at 236% of A.

caveats: Parameter distance is not perceptual distance. Two frames far apart here can look alike, and the reverse.
This was not a pre-registered measure. It was added after round one to explain a keep-rate gap, so it is descriptive, not a tested prediction.
